text: [[example-apps-notes-v2-plus-note_viewer]] is built on bleeding with its federation e2e green, and the 3 defects found along the way are fixed there: [[identity-app-origins-trusted-as-clients]] (PR 30), [[public-op-named-as-its-external-serves-every-row]] (PR 29) and [[two-ops-of-one-name-replace-silently]] (PR 31). The last 2 are in released 0.5.1; no app in the repo is affected, and the fixes ship with 0.5.2. Nothing is building. 0.5.2 waits for PR 13 (held).
